scope: Incremental single-block encrypt/decrypt latency against CURRENT native GPR scalar, not pristine original.
baseline: Snapshot current/kuznechik.zig public Cipher.encrypt/decrypt before hybrid dispatch, unchanged native scalar source. Wrapper receives Cipher by value; messages consume prior ciphertext/plaintext output.

candidate.endpoint: Fully defined vector-shuffle zero extension to 512-bit inverse S-box lookup indices
candidate.field_math: Reuse gfni.toAes and gfni.affineMatrix; only required gfni source change is making these internal helpers pub.

method.timed_scope: Only chained single-block calls; key setup/random generation/checks/printing outside timers
method.output_check: Full 16-byte comparison after every pair; final observable checksum

correctness.basic_reference: 4096 independently random plaintexts and4096 arbitrary ciphertexts across32 keys per final harness; all native/compact/defined constructor variants equal basic L/S/key transforms.
correctness.contributions: Initial variants: all16x256 forward contributions against existing tables. Final compact unit: all5x256 forward, inverse, raw-first inverse contributions, plus every inverse S-box byte.
correctness.unit_suites: Compact8 imported/module tests pass; fully defined constructor suite all10 tests pass on Boat VM B.
correctness.known_scope: Baseline existing tests cover RFC vectors; main performs integrated validation separately.

constructor_cleanup.decision: Choose fully defined vector-shuffle zero extension; timing effectively flat versus undefined upper lanes, faster than array construction.

discovery.hypothesis: Encoded S-box once with VBMI each round
Keep whole state in AES field with conjugated remaining tables
Compute compressed partial in SIMD, keep remainder and state in GPRs
Pure vector LUT with forced GPR indices, compression0
Dense remaining lookup groups and leading5 compressed
discovery.decision: Accept shared leading5/groups3; small groups2 difference not worth separate policy

discovery.hypothesis: Force multiplication and inverse-affine coefficients into SIMD registers
discovery.decision: No consistent gain; memory-folded vm retained

source_note: Scratch gfni differs from baseline only in pub visibility of toAes/affineMatrix. Candidate imports same existing LUT module as public baseline.
